summary: Rabbi Hidary looks at cases in Masekhet Pesahim where combinations of people are pure, have corpse impurity, or are a Zav. He considers who does Pesah Rishon, who does Pesah Sheni, and who does not do Pesah at all according to Rav, Ula, and Shemuel. The class also deals with the Mishna regarding unknown impurity, Tumat HaTehom, and whether the Sitz atones for a Kohen.
subjects: Opinion of Rabbi Elazar ben Matya
questions: What happens when half the community is pure and half has impurity?
How do Rav and Ula resolve an exact half-and-half division between pure and impure people?
Can a minority with corpse impurity bring Pesah Rishon or Pesah Sheni when most of the community are Zavim?
How does the Sitz atone when blood or a person becomes Tameh?
Does the rule of Tumat HaTehom apply to a Kohen as well as the owner?
